reason: I am already looking up a named breach, and lawsuitai.org plus 'free money if you make an account' is exactly the kind of site I assume is a scam. Even if it is real, the checks are like ten dollars and I still have to file on the official site myself, so I would just Google the administrator and skip this.
objection: The payouts are like $10, not worth it — and I am not handing my email to an unverified settlement site after I already got breached.
would_change_my_mind: Let me search the exact breach with no account and land on the official claims-administrator page I already recognize, with a payout that is not ten dollars. I still would not pay for a list of links.
